Add ONLY these accessories: One black satin ribbon neck bow with long pointed tails, worn over the white neck bib. No white bib, white ribbon or pearls included.; 多层珍珠项链; 黑色金圆扣腰带; 金色手链. original_prompt: Edit this white-background object-only product photo. Remove only the detached spare long white pearl necklace at middle right. Keep the one multi-strand pearl necklace already draped on the white blouse chest, the tied black neck bow, the attached gold-circle black waist belt, and adjacent gold bracelet. All clothing and shoes unchanged. No new objects. Preserve pure white background and realistic materials. No person, skin, body parts, mannequin or stand.
